screens.title: Desktop
screens.description: Compose an original bright wallpaper and several beveled local windows with working visibility controls.

screens.title: Mail
screens.description: Browse invented inbox rows and update a separate mail detail window, keeping any suspicious link inert.

screens.title: File Library
screens.description: Inspect original pixel-style file tiles and toggle local demo state without downloading or installing anything.

limitations: Wallpaper, pages, mail, filenames, senders, dates, and file states are original fictional demo content.
Window and file controls update only local prototype state; no files are downloaded or installed.
A parent-captured component image and independent three-screen implementation are pending.
